evidence.claim: Full-test retrieval-only results including 7405 HotpotQA queries were reported by 2026-08-08; BGE was already the encoder; Top-5 and Top-10 and reranker conditions were compared. The Top-10 section expressly avoids additional method-selection recommendations.
The saved replay configuration explicitly covers cutoffs 5,10,20,50 and the original HotpotQA full-test suite.
The historical policy replay manifest binds the HotpotQA Top-50 BM25 and Dense result paths and their historical payload hashes; payloads were not opened or rehashed in this audit.
The manifest-bound replay uses 21 alpha values, two candidate-budget protocols, and test-qrels best-alpha/query oracles; it reports no new retrieval or model inference.
A saved 2026-08-09 passed replay check binds the same manifest, 21 alphas and two protocols.

Historical test-qrels policy exploration explicitly informed Dense-default, sparse/hybrid-exception and HotpotQA multi-evidence-gating research recommendations. Query/family oracle results are descriptive, not a trained policy; answer-level work is proposed later.
The historical four-path synthesis recommends Dense plus BGE reranking for HotpotQA. Recommendation does not establish that the later no-reranker Router adopted that recommendation.

The archive documents original BM25/BGE results joined to the BGE/DPR/Contriever dense matrix, identity-level consistency checks, and retrieval-only exclusions. This audit reads the provenance text rather than per-query payloads.
The dense-family and BM25 comparisons include HotpotQA 7405 and explicitly justify BM25-versus-BGE as a routing research task; they recommend moving labels to answer utility in future.
The archived Router configuration uses train85000, explicitly marks official_test historical_retrieval_evidence_only, and uses candidate50/final5/no-reranker with BGE-small.
The known later Contriever answer experiment uses a frozen train1200 pool and was motivated by Phase2.6 Router failure; it is not evidence of answer-utility exposure on test7405.
The prior bounded inventory found full-test retrieval identity artifacts but no answer/router-effect cache in its stated scope. That absence does not prove no historical use.
